name: cad-viewer
description: Open local STEP and STL models, inspect assemblies, and measure distances in ChatGPT desktop.

interface.displayName: CAD Viewer · 三维查看与测量
interface.shortDescription: View STEP/STL models and measure dimensions locally.
interface.longDescription: Inspect local CAD assemblies with orbit, zoom, part isolation, exploded views, clipping, bounding dimensions, and point-to-point mesh measurement. STEP is converted locally to a display mesh. STL source units are selected explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Open my STEP model and show its dimensions.
打开三维模型并测量两个点之间的距离。
